data.description: Bridgeyate Motor Services offers reliable and affordable car repairs, MOTs, vehicle servicing, and diagnostics in Bristol.

chunks.text: Reliable car & light commercial vehicle servicing, repairs, diagnostics, and MOT testing.

We are a well-established business with many loyal customers who make us their first choice for MOTs, servicing,, and repairs. Our friendly and fully qualified team has over 30 years of experience in the industry, with a broad knowledge of all vehicles. No matter the age, make or model, we have the ability to get your car repaired and back to you as quickly as possible. Our garage is midway between Bristol and Bath, so if you are looking for a reliable and trustworthy garage for your car or light commercial vehicle, get in touch.

We use cookies to analyze website traffic and optimize your website experience. By accepting our use of cookies, your data will be aggregated with all other user data.

We offer Class 4 MOT tests for all makes and models, as well as light commercial vehicles. The tests are completed by reliable and experienced technicians. You are legally obliged to submit your vehicle for an MOT every year when it reaches 3 years of age, as the test makes sure it is roadworthy and meets all the necessary safety standards. If any issues are found, we offer fairly priced repairs to get you back on the road as soon as possible.

For most vehicles, we would usually suggest getting your car serviced every 12 months or 12,000 miles, whichever comes first. Many modern cars have onboard computers that keep track of when your next service is due. Please do not ignore these warning signs, as they may appear before 12,000 miles. By ensuring your car is checked regularly, we can identify problems early, reducing the risk of serious issues in the future.

Our highly skilled and fully qualified team has experience with all car makes and models, of all ages, and we offer a range of repair services to get your vehicle back to its best. Whether it’s engine repairs, wheel alignment, or clutch replacement, no job is too big or too small for our talented team. We have well-equipped facilities and the latest diagnostic equipment, so if you are having any issues with your vehicle, get in touch with us.

With our skills, experience, and knowledge, we can quickly and easily diagnose a range of problems within your vehicle. If you have noticed an issue or your dashboard lights are flashing, get in touch with us. We use state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment from Snap-On, which gives us accurate information on your car so we can start any necessary repair work. As we are an independent garage, we can offer very competitive prices as well as personal and dedicated services.

From general maintenance and repairs through to full brake pad and disc replacements, we offer professional solutions for all car makes and models. Brakes are an essential part of your car that should be checked regularly to ensure your vehicle is safe for the roads, so if you notice they are feeling spongy or less effective, do not waste time and book your car in with our team.

Our professional and experienced team provides solutions for a wide range of clutch problems. Your clutch is a very integral element of your car’s transmission, and over time, issues can occur. It is important to get your clutch inspected by a team of specialists, so make our team your first call! We can accurately diagnose the problem, offer reliable repairs or a replacement, all for a very competitive price.
